text:
maya: Morning team — quick sync. AMS-1 prewarm spike overnight: headroom down to ~6%. Not triggering autoscale yet but noticed queue climb for llm-infer.

devon: Thanks. Which instance types are hot? GPU-rtx-a10? Any evictions/logs?

maya: Appears mostly a10gspot in europe-west4 (AMS-1). No evictions yet. Latency 95th jumped from 120ms -> 230ms for short seqs.

eng-bot: autoscaler: triggered prewarm policy 'burst-2' at 03:14 UTC — provisioning 4 nodes.

oli: pinging infra to check quota — @jen can you verify region quotas for a10g? Also can we shift some dedicated pools from us-east to europe-west4 temporarily?

jen: I can move one dedicated pool. Need approval from finance for cross-region burst charges? estimate ~ $2.8k/day if continued.

devon: If we can add one node from dedicated it should stabilize. I'll open a quick CR to adjust routing weights.

maya: Thx. @devon CR number?

devon: cr/4821 — changes target policy for llm-infer to prefer dedicated:eu-west buffer +10%.

oli: checking quotas now: output:
```
$ gcloud compute regions describe europe-west4 --project=redwood-prod --format="value(quotas)"
GPUS_A10G: limit=40, usage=36
```
So we only have 4 GPUs spare.

jen: I'll request quota increase (ticket #QT-899) and start transfer of 1 dedicated node. Also triggering fallback to v2-small-quantized for non-critical customers.

maya: Blockers: waiting on quota increase and finance ack. Today: watch metrics, validate CR once merged, coordinate fallback rollout.

devon: I'll monitor canaries and add extra logs to KV cache metrics. :eyes: 

oli: FYI I'll be oncall tonight — ping here if something spikes.

maya: Great — thanks all :thumbsup:
